It is recommended that the number of members per village should be around 20. One additional note is that, according to the 1979 plan to strengthen the development of the Saemaul Youth Association, the village-level Saemaul Youth Associations, composed of individuals aged 13-21, and the township-level Saemaul Youth Associations, composed of individuals aged 22-26, have a dual organizational structure.

From the above, the Li·Dong Development Committee in our country, as a current resident organization, performs its functions as the driving force behind the Saemaul Undong. The functional aspects of this will be described later, but here we will point out the organizational issues of the Li·Dong Development Committee.

Firstly, the main issue with the Li·Dong Development Committee members is that the organization is top-down. That is, the Li·Dong Development Committee was organized in the late 1960s during the reorganization and improvement of resident organizations according to the administrative instructions of the Ministry of the Interior, and thus it was an organization that was initially distant from the residents.

Secondly, as seen in the composition of the Li·Dong Development Committee, the committee is distant from the residents. Specifically, the chairperson of the committee is concurrently the Li·Dong head, and in fact, the Li·Dong head is appointed by the mayor or county governor. Additionally, the committee members are composed of representatives from each functional organization, but most of these functional organizations are organized exogenously by law or administrative orders, and the representatives from each functional organization are unilaterally appointed by the township or village head.

Thirdly, the weakness of the "command ability" or practical power of the Li·Dong Development Committee. Although it is institutionally supposed that the Li·Dong Development Committee should oversee each functional organization, it is not actually doing so in reality. For example, the Li·Dong Development Committee is not properly utilizing organizations such as the Agricultural Cooperatives or local reserve army squads. Additionally, among the functional organizations, there is often overlap in the functions of resident organizations. For example, the Saemaul Youth Association and the agricultural improvement club, the women's association and the life improvement club, and the food production committee and the agricultural contract association are examples of this.

### (2) Function
It can be said that the success of the Saemaul Undong depends on how resident organizations are utilized to promote Saemaul projects. On the other hand, to promote Saemaul projects with the Li·Dong Development Committee as the center, the Saemaul


--- (p. 181) ---

### Chapter 3 (第3章) The Implementation System of the Saemaul Undong (推進體制)

The central body (中心體的) functions (機能) are responsible for strengthening (强化) the coordination (協議調整) functions (機能) and performing tasks such as discussing and deliberating on the immediate problems of the residents (住民), conducting comprehensive surveys (全體調査) of the village (部落), formulating development (開發) plans (計劃), promoting development projects (開發事業) through community cooperation (住民協同), managing and storing (保管) support materials (支援資材), and taking responsibility (責任) for post-management (事後管理) of completed Saemaul projects (새마을事業). These functions (機能) can be further concretized (具體化) and categorized (類型別) as follows:

*   (a) Community Security (鄕保) Functions (機能)
    Crime prevention (防犯), counterintelligence (防諜), fire prevention (防火), flood control (砂防), and other preventive and remedial measures for unforeseen events (豫期) fall under this category.
*   (b) Production (生產) Functions (機能)
    Increasing production (增產), agricultural improvement (農事改良), land reclamation (開墾), water conservancy (水利), and other construction of public facilities (公共設施) are included in this category.
*   (c) Welfare (厚生) Functions (機能)
    Cleaning (淸掃), disinfection (消毒), epidemic prevention (防疫), hygiene (衛生), family planning (家族計劃), and life improvement (生活改善) are included in this category.
*   (d) Social (社會) and Cultural (文化) Functions (機能)
    Mutual aid for celebrations and condolences (慶吊相扶), respect for the elderly (敬老), guidance for the young (年少者善導), sports (體育), reading (讀書), and village events (部落行事) are included in this category.
*   (e) Coordination (協調) Functions (機能)
    Coordination (協議) on village (里) and neighborhood (洞) administration (行政) falls under this category.
*   (f) Development (開發) Functions (機能)
    Deliberation (討議) and decision-making (議決) related to the Saemaul Undong (新村運動) are included in this category.
*   (g) Nomination (薦擧) Functions (機能)
    Nominations (薦擧) for honors (叙勳) for village (里) and neighborhood (洞) leaders (洞長) and meritorious individuals (有功人士) fall under this category.

(3) Organization (機構) and Utilization (活用) of the Village (里) and Neighborhood (洞) Development Committees (開發委員會)

*   (a) Organization (機構)
    The organization (機構) of the Village (里) and Neighborhood (洞) Development Committees (開發委員會) can be divided into decision-making and executive bodies (議決執行機關) and advisory bodies (顧問) for the Development Fund (開發金庫). The decision-making bodies (議決機關) within the Village (里) and Neighborhood (洞) Development Committees (開發委員會) include the Committee Meetings (委員會會議) and General Assemblies (總會). The executive bodies (執行機關) include the Security Department (鄕保部), Youth Department (靑年部), Women's Department (婦女部), and Audit Committee (監査會). Advisory bodies (顧問) include former village (里) and neighborhood (洞) leaders (洞長), civil servants (公務員), and village elders (部落元老). Additionally, the Development Fund (開發金庫) consists of joint property (共同財産), facilities (施設), donations (寄附金品), loans (融資) and subsidies (補助金) from the government (政府) as its financial resources (財源).


--- (p. 182) ---

We will examine the role of the Ri (里) • Dong (洞) Development (開發) Committee (委員會) as the core entity of the New Community Movement.

1. **Business (事業) Planning (計劃) and Preparation (作成)**:
   The Ri (里) • Dong (洞) Development (開發) Committee (委員會) Chairman (委員長) establishes the business (事業) plan (計劃) according to the guidelines for plan (計劃) establishment provided by the City (市) • County (郡). Plan (計劃) establishment (樹立) involves first convening the committee (委員會) to draft the plan (計劃) and then holding a general assembly (總會) to finalize it. The finalized plan (計劬) is submitted to the City (市) • County (郡), and upon receiving the business (事業) plan (計劃) confirmation (確定) notice and detailed implementation (施行) guidelines from the City (市) • County (郡), the Chairman (委員長) prepares the detailed business (事業) promotion (推進) plan (計劃). The plan (計劃) approved at the Residents' General Assembly (住民 總會議) is also reported to the City (市) • County (郡) through the Eup (邑) • Myeon (面).

2. **Business (事業) Implementation (實施)**:
   According to the detailed business (事業) promotion (推進) plan (計劃), the Ri (里) • Dong (洞) Development (開發) Committee (委員會) Chairman (委員長) first allocates and collects residents' (住民) burdens (負擔), applies for and secures external (外部) support (支援) such as materials (資材), funds (資金), and technical (技術) assistance (支援), and, with the guidance (指導) of the City (市) • County (郡)'s civil engineering (土木) technical (技術) personnel (要員), designs the construction (工作物) plans (設計). Once these preparatory (準備) processes are complete, full-scale business (事業) implementation (實施) begins. The executive (執行) departments (部署) of the committee (委員會), such as the Youth Department (靑年部), Women's Department (婦女部), and Local Security Department (鄕保部), assist the Chairman (委員長) in carrying out the business (事業) in their respective (擔當) fields (分野).

3. **Business (事業) Results (結果) Reporting (報告)**:
   The Ri (里) • Dong (洞) Development (開發) Committee (委員會) Chairman (委員長) reports the progress (推進) of the business (事業) to the Eup (邑) • Myeon (面) head (長) on a weekly (週別) and monthly (月別) basis. The Chairman (委員長) also convenes committee (委員會) meetings (會議) at the end of each week and month to evaluate (評價) the business (事業) progress (推進) for the week and month. At the end of the year, a Residents' General Assembly (住民 總會議) is convened to report and evaluate (評價) the annual (年間) business (事業) results (結果).

Evaluations (評價) of business (事業) promotion (推進) are documented (書面) and kept on file to serve as important materials for the next (次期) plan (計劃) drafting (作成).

Thus, we have explained the operational (運營) system (體系) of the New Community Movement, focusing on business (事業) planning (計劃) and development (發展) structure (體制). Summarizing the coordination (協調) system (體系) for promoting (推進) the New Community Movement discussed so far concisely is as follows <Table 3>.

The organizational (組織) structure (組織) for promoting (推進) the New Community Movement, as outlined above, is undoubtedly a general (一般) administrative (行政) organization (組織). Therefore, the various (諸般) principles (原理) of organization (組織) apply, and there is no difference in administrative (行政) operations (業務) or management (管理) techniques (技術).

However, the main (主體) entity (主體) of the New Community Movement is the residents (住民), and its business (事業) relies on its own (自體) funds (基金).

The government's objective is to develop community organizations (住民組織) by encouraging voluntary participation (參與) through incentives (刺戟) and motivation (動機). Therefore, specialization (專門) and decentralization (分權化) are required, and in budget execution (豫算執行), it should not be limited to simply achieving policy goals (政策目標).


--- (p. 184) ---

The functions in the Saemaul Undong are different from those in general administration (一般行政). Under a single guiding ideology (指導理念), it should maintain a close cooperative system (協調體制) with residents (住民) while fulfilling their demands, alongside performing adjusting (調整的) and promoting (促進的) functions.

The democratic principles (民主原則) of the promotion and cooperation organizations (推進協調組織) of the Saemaul Undong, as mentioned earlier, are as follows. (Shin Daesoon (申大淳), "Regional Community Development Theory (地域社會開發論)," Seyoungsa (世英社), 1978, PP. 125〜126)

First, the Saemaul Undong should be promoted through the creativity (創意) and voluntary participation (自發的參與) of residents (住民), centered around resident organizations.

Second, the promotion organizations should maintain close human relationships (人間關係) with residents (住民) to gain their trust and followership.

Third, the promotion organizations should select projects (事業) based on the common needs of residents (住民) and obtain their consent (同意).

Fourth, the promotion organizations should guide (指導) residents (住民) to maximize the use of the village's (部落) human (人的) and material (物的) resources (資源), provide technical (技術) guidance, and partially support the necessary materials.

Fifth, consistent policy goals (政策目標) for the Saemaul Undong should be explained, and long-term and short-term plans to achieve these goals should be established. Additionally, appropriate personnel (人士) recruitment and training should support these efforts, along with continuous evaluation (評價) and research (硏究) of the promotion projects.

Sixth, the promotion organizations should focus on expanding Saemaul education (教育) and promoting and stimulating voluntary participation (參與) of residents (住民).

When these principles are well observed, the promotion results of the Saemaul Undong will be further enhanced.

## 2. Business Operation System (事業運營體制)

For a society (社會) to undergo change and achieve continuous development (發展), two main factors (要因) must be satisfied: internal (內生的) factors within the regional community system (地域社會體制) and external (外生的) factors.

Policies (政策) should foster and grow these internal (內生的) development factors (發展要因) through administration (行政) and transition to appropriate support policies (支援政策) according to the stages of change (變動).


--- (p. 185) ---

## Chapter 3: The Implementation System of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement)

The Saemaul Undong's business operation system forms an administrative guidance system for the movement, enabling the execution of its projects. While the planning and development system mentioned earlier appears to be composed of and function through the participation of various ministries and related agencies, the execution stage of the Saemaul Undong's projects is primarily centralized under the strong guidance, command, and control of local administrative agencies, which are under the jurisdiction of the central administrative organization, the Ministry of Home Affairs. In short, the business operation system is run under the strong and comprehensive system of the Ministry of Home Affairs. Therefore, while the general local administration primarily deals with administrative and public security tasks, it also plays a central executive role in carrying out the development tasks of the Saemaul Undong.

Examining the factors that make government guidance and support indispensable elements of the Saemaul Undong in South Korea, we can summarize them as follows:

First, the spirit of self-help and self-reliance, as well as the willingness to cooperate and develop, among residents is extremely weak, necessitating government participation.

Second, the residents' income levels are low, and thus the material foundation of the movement—the financial resources—is extremely weak, requiring government subsidies and support.

Third, the residents' farming methods and lifestyles have not escaped traditional practices, and the technological level necessary for development is extremely low, necessitating government technical guidance.

Fourth, although the aforementioned spirit, finances, and technology are lacking, there might be some self-sacrificing and capable leaders within the village who could, given time, lead the village's own development. However, such leaders are either non-existent or unwilling to take the lead among the residents, making it necessary for the government to discover and cultivate leaders.

Due to the aforementioned factors, government guidance and support have become indispensable elements of the Saemaul Undong in South Korea. However, the depth of these factors has led to a situation where the government cannot but take the lead in the movement. The operation system of the Saemaul Undong is structured and powerful, with clear information flows in regional guidance division systems and cooperative promotion systems.


--- (p. 186) ---

Through explicit (明示的) communication, the input (投入) and output relationships (産出關係) of each (各) subordinate system (下位體制) are connected. Furthermore, the administrative guidance system of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement) in our country underwent changes over nearly 10 years, gradually moving towards decentralization (分權化), specialization (專門化), and structuration (構造化) in organizational theory (組織理論), thereby enhancing the efficiency (効率性) of development project (開發事業) execution.

Here, we will first examine the organizational evolution (組織變遷) of the business operation system (事業運營體制) known as the "Saemaul Undong Administrative Guidance System," and then explore the functions (機能) of the current (現在) organizational structure (組織體系).

### Administrative Organization (行政組織) Evolution (變遷)

The guiding agencies (指導機關) of the Saemaul Undong refer to government agencies (政府機關) and private organizations (民間團體) that ignite (點火), promote (促進), and coordinate (調整) the residents' (住民) participation in the movement. These guiding agencies (指導機關), based on the characteristics (特性) of their affiliated organizations (組織), perform their unique functions (機能). The diverse (多樣한) functions (機能) of these agencies (機關) combine to enable a comprehensive (綜合的) approach to the Saemaul Undong.

Guiding agencies (指導機關) can be categorized based on the nature of their guidance functions into general administrative agencies (一般行政機關) and project guidance agencies (事業指導機關). General administrative agencies (一般行政機關) are government agencies (政府機關) that provide the framework for the implementation of development projects, known as the Saemaul projects. Project guidance agencies (事業指導機關), on the other hand, are agencies (機關) that directly oversee the implementation of these projects. Here, we will focus on the general administrative agencies (一般行政機關) and briefly examine the evolution (變遷) of their organizations (組織).

#### (1) Central Administrative Organization (中央行政組織)

In our country, the central administrative organization (中央行政組織) for regional community development (地域社會開發) has historical (歷史的) roots that can be traced back, but the dedicated department (專擔部署) for the Saemaul Undong is relatively recent. The establishment of a dedicated department (專擔部署) within the Ministry of Home Affairs (內務部), which oversees personnel (人事) and financial (財政) authority related to major local administrative agencies (地方行政機構) involved in the Saemaul projects, marked the beginning of the central administrative organization (中央行政組織) for the Saemaul Undong. In other words, on August 19, 1971, through the amendment of the Ministry of Home Affairs' (內務部) organizational regulations (職制改正) by Presidential Decree (大統領令) No. 5755, the former "Development Division (開發課)" under the Local Affairs Bureau (地方局) was abolished, and new positions such as "Regional Development Officer (地域開發擔當官)," "Urban Development Officer (都市開發官)," "Rural Development Officer (農村開發官)," and "Housing Improvement Officer (住宅改良官)" were created under the Local Affairs Bureau Chief (地方局長). This marked the first instance of a dedicated department (專擔部署) within the central administrative organization (中央行政組織) for the Saemaul Undong.


--- (p. 187) ---

## Chapter 3: The Implementation System of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement)

A dedicated village department was established. Furthermore, on January 14, 1972, the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperatives established the "Dongnongga Research Institute (篤農家硏修院)" under its jurisdiction. Additionally, the Roof Improvement Promotion Act for Agricultural and Fishing Villages was amended by Law No. 2385 on December 26, 1972, transferring the roof improvement-related work from the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries to the Ministry of Home Affairs.

Consequently, on January 16, 1973, the Ministry of Home Affairs revised its organizational structure (Presidential Decree No. 6458), renaming the "Regional Development Officer (地域開發擔當官)" under the Local Affairs Bureau to "Saemaul Officer (擔當官)" and newly establishing the "Saemaul Planning Analysis Officer (計劃分析官)." Furthermore, the "Rural (農村), Urban (都市), and Housing Improvement Officer (住宅改良官)" established in 1971 was abolished, and the "Saemaul Guidance Division (指導課)," "Urban Guidance Division (都市指導課)," and "Housing Guidance Division (住宅指導課)" were newly established under the Local Affairs Bureau.

Starting with the experimental project in 1971, the Saemaul Undong had, by 1973, established the foundation for voluntary practice throughout that year. In other words, by 1973, related departments within the central administrative organization had almost all been established, marking the solidification of the administrative organization's foundation for promoting the Saemaul Undong. As emphasized several times before, the Saemaul Undong, being a nationwide, multi-purpose project, could not be operated by the administrative organization of a single ministry alone. Therefore, it became inevitable to revise the organizational structure of the central administrative organization related to the Saemaul Undong to ensure its rational operation and guidance system.

Thus, on January 16, 1973, not only the Ministry of Home Affairs but also the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries (Presidential Decree No. 6459) and the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (Presidential Decree No. 6460) revised their organizational structures. Examining the contents of these revisions, the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries established the "Saemaul Income Division (所得課)" under the Rural Development Bureau, while the Ministry of Commerce and Industry established the "Agricultural Processed Products Development Division (農家工產品開發課)" under the Small and Medium Business Bureau and the "Fishing Village Modernization Division (漁村近代化課)" under the Energy Development Bureau.

Furthermore, the Ministry of Education revised its organizational structure (Presidential Decree No. 6531) to place a "Saemaul Education Officer (敎育擔當官)" under the Scholarship Office, tasked with overseeing various educational guidance related to the Saemaul Undong. According to the revision of the organizational structure of the Ministry of Health and Social Affairs on March 10, 1973 (Presidential Decree No. 6539), the "Regional Welfare Division (地域福祉課)" was established under the Social Affairs Bureau, and the "Saemaul Business Division (事業部)" was newly established under the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperatives.

Meanwhile, the "Dongnongga Research Institute (篤農家硏修院)" under the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperatives was renamed the "Saemaul Leader Training Institute (指導者硏修院)" in 1972 to conduct training for leaders promoting the Saemaul Undong.


--- (p. 188) ---

It was. On February 1, 1974 (年), the "New Community Leadership Division (指導部)" was newly established at the Central Fisheries Cooperative Association (水協中央會), and the following year, the Ministry of Home Affairs (內務部) revised the New Community Movement (새마을運動) regulations (Presidential Decree (大統領令) No. 7505 (號)) to strengthen the comprehensive planning (綜合計劃) and educational promotion (敎育弘報) functions of the New Community Movement (새마을運動). The New Community Planning Analysis Office (計劃分析官室) was renamed the "New Community Planning Division (企劃課)," and the Housing Guidance Division (住宅指導課) was abolished, establishing the "New Community Education Division (敎育課)" anew.

On the other hand, a nationwide (全國) overview (一覽) of New Community Education Institutions (敎育機關) shows that as of October 31, 1980 (年), a total (總) of 82 (個) New Community Education Institutions (敎育機關) are scattered (散在) throughout the country.

Looking at these institutions by agency (機關別), there are 18 (個) educational institutions (敎育機關) under the central government (中央政府), 22 (個) under local self-governing bodies (地方自治團體), and 42 (個) training institutions (硏修機關) established by private enterprises (企業體) and other private entities (民間).

As described above, we have examined the organizational structure (構成) and changes (變動) of central administrative organizations (中央行政組織) dedicated to the New Community Movement (새마을運動), as well as the number (數) of educational institutions (敎育機關). ## (2) Local Administrative Organization (地方行政組織)

On October 17, 1972 (年), the President (大統領) declared in a special (特別) declaration (宣言) that "the New Community Movement (새마을運動) will be promoted as the top priority (最優先) task (課業) of national (國家) policy (施策)." The following year, on February 1, 1973 (年), the New Community


--- (p. 189) ---

## Chapter 3: The Implementation Structure of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement)

Reorganization of city and provincial agencies for the movement's implementation was carried out. Specifically, "Saemaul Guidance Bureaus" were newly established in each city and province, and "Saemaul Bureaus" were established in cities, counties, and districts. Through this, official administrative organizations responsible for the operation and guidance of the Saemaul Undong were created not only in the central administrative organization but also in the frontline administrative organization.

On the other hand, these city and provincial Saemaul dedicated departments took village development through projects and spiritual development through education as their main missions, and also oversaw Saemaul promotion work.

However, on January 1, 1975, the duties of the Saemaul Bureaus in cities and counties, which had been in charge of the Saemaul Undong, were transferred to the newly established vice-mayors. In other words, all the Saemaul Bureaus in counties across the nation were abolished, and the system of vice-mayors in charge of Saemaul (local government grade 3) was newly established, and the Saemaul section, planning and budget section, and audit functions were granted directly under the vice-mayors. Therefore, the Saemaul dedicated departments were reinforced with 276 personnel (2 per county), and on January 15, 1975, a Saemaul situation room was established to grasp the progress and issues of the Saemaul projects and to smoothly promote the Saemaul projects. Saemaul situation rooms were established in the central government at the Ministry of Home Affairs, and in cities and provinces, and cities and counties, respectively, in the Saemaul dedicated departments. However, on September 29 of the same year, a "Saemaul Comprehensive Situation Room" was established to confirm and analyze the progress of the Saemaul projects and the comprehensive situation of local administration, and dedicated personnel were dispatched not only to the central government but also to cities and provinces.

On May 7, 1976, Saemaul Bureaus were newly established in Anseong City and Bucheon City, Gyeonggi Province, and Saemaul sections and development sections were established to efficiently promote the urban Saemaul Undong.

Meanwhile, on March 27, 1978, an agency for promoting rural housing improvement projects was established. At that time, among the five major priority policies of the Saemaul Undong, administrative support was provided to expand the rural housing improvement policy. To this end, bureaus were established in provinces, and sections were established in cities and counties. The background of the formation of such promotional agencies can be seen to have originated from President Park's remark during his New Year's inspection of the Ministry of Home Affairs on February 2, 1978, that "within a few years, our rural areas must be completely transformed into the form of rural areas in an advanced country," and his instruction to relevant agencies to cooperate and promote the rural housing improvement projects without any negligence.


--- (p. 190) ---

To sustain, intensify, and activate the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement), the government established five major policies in 1979: expanding the welfare foundation of Saemaul, promoting income growth, deepening urban Saemaul movements, spreading factory Saemaul movements, and strengthening national education for Saemaul. Consequently, the Saemaul division (課), which had been abolished with the implementation of the vice-county magistrate system (副郡守制) in 1975, was revived on July 15, 1979. These government measures aimed to shift all local administrative policies to a village-centered system, particularly improving the administration of local towns and districts, and actively enhancing guidance for villages. Furthermore, all Saemaul projects were linked to residents' income, adhering to the principle of completeness by function and system.

Thus, examining the changes in local administrative organizations and the establishment of Saemaul movement promotion bodies, some scholars argue that local administration centered around the Saemaul Undong, which began in the early 1970s, eventually transformed into an administration focused on:
1. Developing village units (部落單位)
2. Stimulating administration for common interests of residents (住民)
3. Shifting from an economically-centered administration to a socially welfare-centered one (社會福祉的)

This transformation is seen as the emergence of "Saemaul Administration" (新村行政), highlighting the historical significance of the Saemaul Undong or Saemaul Administration in local administration.

Several characteristics can be summarized from the organizational changes observed so far.

Firstly, in the early 1970s, administrative formal organizations promoting the Saemaul Undong were mostly part of central organizations. However, they gradually extended to local administrative organizations while maintaining a strong centralized system. This is evident in the establishment of the Saemaul Undong headquarters within the central administrative organization, the Ministry of Home Affairs (內務部), and the creation of the Saemaul Comprehensive Situation Room (綜合狀況室) for unified and comprehensive situation analysis. The structure of the Saemaul Comprehensive Situation Room can be summarized as follows (Table 5):

Secondly, another notable characteristic is the strengthening of the Saemaul administrative organization. As previously mentioned, to enhance frontline Saemaul tasks, the system of appointing a vice-county magistrate (副郡守制) as a local secretary (地方書記官) to oversee Saemaul duties was introduced. This led to the establishment of an independent division (課) on July 15, 1979, reinforcing the administrative structure.


--- (p. 191) ---

# Chapter 3: The Implementation System of the Saemaul Undong (Movement)

Furthermore, outstanding civil servants were selected and dispatched to city and provincial Saemaul offices, and systems such as performance evaluation bonus points, a two-year service limit, and priority promotion were applied to strengthen the internal vitality of the Saemaul administrative organization.

Lastly, a notable aspect observed in the evolution of the Saemaul administrative organization is that in the early 1970s, the role of the administrative organization was centered on rural development. However, in the latter part of the 1970s, the Saemaul Movement expanded to include factories and urban areas.

## B. The Role of the Business Operations System (事業運營體制)

The business operations system (事業運營體制) is responsible for annually operating the projects (事業) established by the planning (計劃) and development systems (發展體制). The business operations system (事業運營體制) receives support from the technical (技術) and administrative support systems (行政支援體制). While performing the conversion process (轉換過程) that leads to production through such support, it evaluates the project plans (事業計劃), assesses their effects (効果), and establishes development plans (發展計劃).

Therefore, the roles of the business operations system (事業運營體系) can be categorized into two main types: roles in the conversion process (轉換過程) and roles in the feedback process (環流過程). In the conversion process (轉換過程), education and publicity (敎育弘報), administrative guidance (行政指導), and technical guidance (技術指導) are provided. In the feedback process (環流過程), evaluation (評價) and comprehensive analysis (綜合分析) of the situation (狀況) are conducted to implement new policy measures (是正措置). This will be examined through the Saemaul regional (地域別) civil servants in charge (擔當公務員) system (制).

### (1) Roles in the Conversion Process (轉換過程)

#### (a) Saemaul Education (敎育)

Saemaul education (敎育) is a process that cultivates the spirit of diligence (勤勉), self-help (自助), and cooperation (協同) to foster the will for development (發展意志) among village residents (住民) and to develop the knowledge (知識) and skills (技術) necessary for building a better village. This can be seen as a comprehensive form of community education (地域社會敎育) targeting all residents (全體住民) participating in village life (生活), who are ultimately the practitioners of the Saemaul Undong. Such educational activities are not only carried out by the government's (政府) Saemaul Undong (運動) related departments (關係部署) but are also implemented in schools (學校) responsible for formal education (正規敎育) in recent times.

#### ① Characteristics of Saemaul Education (敎育)

Education (敎育) is inherently a prerequisite for the growth (成長) and development (發展) of individuals (個人) or society (社會). In promoting the Saemaul Undong (運動), the role of the administrative guidance system (行政指導體制) includes Saemaul educational activities (敎育活動) that guide the results of project implementation (事業施行) to be achieved more effectively (効果的) and efficiently (能率的) in the conversion process (轉換過程). Saemaul education (敎育) has the following characteristics that distinguish it from other forms of education (他敎育):

First, looking at the goals (目標) of Saemaul education (敎育), the Saemaul Undong (運動) is a nationwide effort (汎國民的努力過程) to build a prosperous village and a thriving nation (繁榮하는 나라) based on the principles of diligence (勤勉), self-help (自助), and cooperation (協同).


--- (p. 193) ---

# Chapter 3 (第3章) The Implementation System of the Saemaul Undong (새마을운동)

Therefore, the goal of Saemaul education (敎育) is to cultivate and acquire the spirit (精神), attitude (態度), knowledge (知識), and skills (技術) that residents (住民) need to carry out the Saemaul Undong (運動). To achieve such goals of Saemaul education (敎育), the focus of the education (敎育) is as follows.

First, in Saemaul education (敎育), the focus is on understanding (理解) the local community (地域社會) closest to the residents' (住民) lives, analyzing (分析) the problems (問題) that the society (社會) faces, and devising (方案) solutions (問題解決), as well as cooperative (協同的) practice (實踐) and evaluation (評價).

Second, since Saemaul education (敎育) involves residents (住民) discussing (共同) and solving (共同) matters of common (共同的) interest (關心事), it emphasizes (自發的) voluntary (參與) participation (參與) and active (積極的) cooperation (協同) from the residents (住民들).

In short, Saemaul education (敎育) aims to be elite education (精銳敎育), specialized education (專門敎育), and life education (生活敎育).

When organizing the promotion (推進) policy (方針) according to the administrative (行政) guidance (指導) system (體系), it is as follows.

### ② Forms of Saemaul Education (敎育)

On April 15, 1976 (年月日), the city (市) and provincial (道) governments strengthened (補强) the functions (機能) of Saemaul guidance (指導) and (課) and established (新設) the education (敎育) publicity (弘報) division (係). The forms (形態) of Saemaul education (敎育) carried out (實施) in these administrative organizations (行政組織) are diverse (多樣).

First, there are program-based (式) education (敎育) and on-site training (現場實習) education (敎育). Typically, Saemaul education (敎育) is conducted (實施) by having individuals enroll (入所) or join (加入) a certain (一定) educational institution (敎育機關) or organization (團體), follow (履修) a certain (一定) curriculum (敎科課程) for a certain (一定) period (期間), and complete (履修) a certain (一定) set of courses (敎科). This is what we usually refer to as Saemaul education (敎育).
However, on-site training (現場實習) education (敎育), which is centered (中心) on real life (實生活) in the field (現場), is also valuable (價值).


--- (p. 194) ---

First, such education is evaluated as highly effective. In other words, this type of education is not only more specific, practical, and reality-oriented than programmatic education, but it also develops the creativity of all participating residents, cultivates their leadership, and fosters their democratic cooperative abilities.

Second, there are residential education and club learning activities. Generally, residential education is conducted by official institutions. In other words, the role of education guidelines in the operational system of the Saemaul Undong is usually in the form of residential education.

On the other hand, club learning activities are also conducted by organizations such as YMCA, YWCA, and women's classes, but they are typically carried out in private, informal organizations.

As explained above, the Saemaul education is officially conducted in a total of 82 educational institutions nationwide. All educational activities carried out within the administrative guidance system are handled by these educational institutions.

Looking at the content of the education that has been implemented so far, it ranges from Saemaul spiritual development, resident guidance methods, agricultural techniques, specialized agricultural techniques by crop, and agricultural machinery operation instructions. In terms of spiritual education, issues related to historical views or ideology occupy the main content of the curriculum. In this regard, Saemaul education should be conducted in a direction that can diversify and specialize technical education.

### (b) Saemaul Promotion

Saemaul promotion is part of the supporting agencies' business in promoting the Saemaul Undong throughout all stages. It refers to the process of promoting voluntary participation and active cooperation of residents by widely publicizing the goals, success stories, and achievements of the Saemaul Undong.

Such promotion performs the following functions:

First, it disseminates the Saemaul spirit to all citizens;

Second, it disseminates the methods and techniques needed for Saemaul projects;

Third, it induces active participation in Saemaul projects; and

Fourth, it functions to sustain and expand the Saemaul Undong.

#### ① Means and Content of Saemaul Promotion

The means of Saemaul promotion are diverse, including mass media, publications, conferences, and popular songs, among others.


--- (p. 195) ---

### Chapter 3: The Promotion System of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement)

Summarized and categorized, the promotion of the Saemaul Undong can be divided into several types. First, there are mass media such as newspapers, radio, TV, and films. Second, there are various publications including magazines, books, novels, critiques, collections of papers, and pamphlets. Third, there are touring lectures, leaders' conferences, discussion meetings, case presentation meetings, exhibitions, and competitions.

The content of the Saemaul Undong promotion using these various means varies depending on the specific situation. The content can be summarized as follows:
* The ideology and necessity of the Saemaul Undong,
* Methods and techniques needed for the Saemaul Undong,
* Success stories,
* Comprehensive achievements of the Saemaul Undong, future plans, and tasks.

#### ② Status of Saemaul Undong Promotion

The government established the Saemaul Broadcasting Consultative Council on August 14, 1973. This council, composed of the director of the broadcasting division of the then Ministry of Culture and Information, and the editors-in-chief of broadcasting and TV stations, aimed to ensure consistency and efficiency in the promotion of the Saemaul Undong.

Furthermore, the government designated the promotion of the Saemaul Undong as a key policy starting in 1975 and actively pursued mobile promotion, wave-like promotion, and three-dimensional promotion. To this end, the government organized and operated mobile promotion teams at the city and provincial levels and continued to carry out touring promotions. Additionally, the government established permanent Saemaul promotion centers in the central areas of provincial capitals and kept them open year-round to display photographs and promotional materials, and to screen slides and films, ensuring continuous daily promotion.

In rural areas, promotion activities were centered around the Saemaul divisions in all 139 counties nationwide. These divisions targeted remote and under-served areas such as mountainous regions, islands, and isolated areas for promotion activities. They also organized inspections of exemplary villages within the county for lagging village leaders. Moreover, outstanding villages were introduced to visiting foreigners, Saemaul total reports in foreign languages were directly distributed or sent abroad, and the Saemaul Undong was introduced at international seminars, thereby promoting the Saemaul Undong to the world.


--- (p. 196) ---

### (Da) Administrative Guidance (行政指導)
The guidance function (指導機能) of the Saemaul Undong (新村運動) operating system (運營體系) has proven to be very important, as objectively evaluated (評價) at the 10-year (年) mark of the movement. In other words, from the initiation of the Saemaul Undong in 1971 to the present day, the government (政府) has made significant efforts (努力) in training leaders, providing technical guidance (技術指導), and supporting with materials (資材) and funds (資金).

However, the government's (政府) guidance (指導) and support (支援) ultimately aim to promote voluntary (自發的) participation (參與) by residents (住民). Therefore, the government's (政府) role in the Saemaul Undong (新村運動) is indirect (間接的), differing from its direct (直接的) administrative activities (行政活動). Administrative guidance (行政指導) refers to creating and promoting the necessary conditions (與件) and procedural (節次的) capabilities (能力) for the success (成功) of Saemaul projects (事業). This includes administrative (行政上) procedures (節次) for project selection (事業), economic (經濟) figures (數値), procedures (節次) for pooling private property (私有財產) for communal projects (共同事業), legal (法的) procedures (節次), and post-management (事後管理) methods (方法), among other issues (問題).

### (Ta) Material Support (物的支援)
Here, support (支援) refers to material (物的) assistance, which can be further divided into financial support (財政支援) and equipment support (裝備支援). First, financial support (財政支援) includes providing funds (資金) and materials (資材) for Saemaul projects (事業). For reference, the following table summarizes the annual (各年度別) financial support (資金支援) status (狀況) (Table 7).

Material support (資材支援) involves providing materials such as fly ash (浮灰) and reinforcing bars (鐵筋), with support methods (支援方法) including free distribution (無償配付) and issuance guarantees (交拂保證). Second, equipment support (裝備支援) refers to providing equipment (裝備) such as soil pipe-making (土管製作) frames, block-making (製作) frames, and formworks (거푸집) for the implementation (遂行) of Saemaul projects (事業), using lending (貸與) and transfer (讓渡) methods (方法).

...the government's material support should be provided only in cases where the residents cannot solve the problem by their own efforts. The scale of support should also be determined considering the residents' capabilities.

**(4) Technical Guidance (技術指導)**
In the operation of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement), technical guidance refers to the dissemination, demonstration, and education of specialized knowledge and techniques related to income increase, environmental improvement, and project promotion. This includes guidance on farming methods, seed improvement methods, disinfection methods, design methods, and construction methods. Residents involved in the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement) often lack such specialized knowledge and techniques. The success of Saemaul projects is seen as dependent on the residents' motivation and the resolution of technical issues that follow.

**(2) Role in the Feedback Process (環流過程)**
To smoothly promote Saemaul projects, it is necessary to understand the progress and issues of the projects, as well as to confirm and analyze the overall situation in each administrative operation system to take corrective actions. For this purpose, the administrative guidance system, from the central government to local governments such as provinces and cities, deploys responsible personnel and forms a unified system. Here, we examine the composition and operation of the regional responsible civil servant system that carries out these tasks.

### ① Provincial/City Responsible Civil Servant System (市道擔當公務員制)
A system is implemented where provincial/city responsible personnel are composed of civil servants at the section chief level or higher from the Ministry of Interior headquarters. In operation, they conduct on-site visits to the relevant provinces/cities and villages at least once a month to comprehensively inspect and confirm the progress of the Saemaul movement.

### ② City/County Responsible Civil Servant System (市郡擔當公務員制)
The city/county responsible personnel are composed of civil servants at the section chief level or higher from the provinces/cities. In operation, they conduct on-site visits to the relevant villages at least twice a month to inspect and confirm the progress of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement).

### ③ Township/Neighborhood Responsible Civil Servant System (邑面洞擔當公務員制)
The township/neighborhood responsible civil servant system is composed of civil servants at the section chief level or higher from the city/county.

# Chapter 3: The Implementation System of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement)

As a result, operations are conducted by visiting the relevant towns (읍), townships (면), and neighborhoods (동) as well as villages at least once a month to inspect, confirm, and guide the progress of the Saemaul Undong.

④ Village Responsible Civil Servant (Village Responsible Public Official) System
When organized, civil servants from towns (읍), townships (면), and neighborhoods (동) are assigned to implement a system where one civil servant is responsible for one village. Operations are conducted by visiting villages at least twice a week and at any time to guide Saemaul projects and inspect the progress. On the first day of every month, "Saemaul Day," all officials visit villages to boost the residents' Saemaul spirit.

(3) Evaluation
Evaluation is seen as particularly significant in the context of Saemaul project implementation, as it identifies issues during the process and incorporates them into the next plan. The evaluation of projects is conducted by the village (리) or neighborhood (동) development committee chairperson, who convenes the village (리) or neighborhood (동) development committee. Evaluations are reported to the town (읍) or township (면) mayor on a weekly or monthly basis.

The town (읍) or township (면) mayor then holds a town (읍) or township (면) development promotion committee meeting to evaluate the reports from the villages (리) and neighborhoods (동) and submit bi-weekly and monthly evaluations to the city (시) or county (군). Additionally, the mayor (시장) or county magistrate (군수) holds a city (시) or county (군) Saemaul Council meeting to evaluate the progress of the projects on a monthly basis.

# Section 3: Project-Specific Implementation System of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement)

## 1. Business Structure of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement)

The projects promoted by the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement) are projects in which multiple departments participate. Therefore, it is not possible to relate them to the mission or goals of a single agency, but rather, projects from each department that are related to the Saemaul Undong, i.e., projects that contribute to achieving the purpose of the Saemaul Undong, are bundled together to form the Saemaul projects. In this context, many projects that each department has been promoting for a long time are integrated into the structure of Saemaul projects as Saemaul projects. A representative example is the Ministry of Education and Culture (문).


--- (p. 200) ---

Under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education (교부(敎部)), there were student volunteer activities (학생봉사활동(學生奉仕活動)); under the Ministry of Resources (동자부(動資部)), there were rural electrification projects (농어촌전화사업(農漁村電化事業)); under the Ministry of Health and Social Affairs (보건사회부(保健社會部)), there were mobile medical services (이동진료(移動診療)) and family planning movements (가족계획운동(家族計劃運動)); and under the Ministry of Communications (체신부(遞信部)), there were village communication facility projects (마을통신시설사업(마을通信施設事業)), among others.

Moreover, there were cases where the same projects were carried out by multiple ministries. On the other hand, the concept of project structure (사업구조(事業構造)) (or program system (프로그램 체계(體系))) is used in the planning budget system (계획예산제도(計劃豫算制度)), and we will examine the promotion system (추진체계(推進體系)) of each project sector (사업부문별(事業部門別)) of the Saemaul Undong by borrowing (원용(援用)) this concept (개념(槪念)).

The structure (구조(構造)) of Saemaul projects (사업(事業)) is classified (분류(分類)) based on three criteria (기준(基準)). These classification criteria (분류기준(分類基準)) include, first, the nature (성격(性格)) of the project itself (사업자체(事業自體)), second, the jurisdiction (소관(所管)) of each ministry (부처별(部處別)), and third, the development stage (발전단계(發展段階)) of the village, among others. In other words, it has a multi-purpose (다목적(多目的)), multi-ministry (다부처적(多部處的)) project structure (사업구조(事業構造)).

Here, as a reference (참고(參考)), we have structurally (구조적(構造的)으로) organized (정리(整理)) the 120 Saemaul projects (사업(事業)) of 1977 (1977년도(年度)) based on the criteria (기준(基準)) of the nature (성격별(性格別)) of the projects (사업(事業)) and the jurisdiction (소관부처별(所管部處別)) of the ministries (부처(部處)). One thing to add (부언할(附言)) is that in November 1980 (1980년(年) 11월(月)), the previous (종래(從來)) stages (단계(段階)) of village development (마을 발전(發展)), such as basic villages (기초마을(基礎마을)), self-help villages (자조마을(自助마을)), and self-reliant villages (자립마을(自立마을)), were re-established (재정립(再定立)) by newly (신설(新設)) operating (운용(運用)) "self-managed villages (자영마을(自營마을))" and "welfare villages (복지마을(福祉마을))" at a higher level (상위수준(上位水準)).

From the above examination of the SAemaul business structure (事業構造), several points can be summarized as follows:

First, the Ministry of Home Affairs (內務部) has mainly promoted many businesses (事業) in the production base (生產基盤) and welfare environment (福祉環境) sectors. In the income increase (所得增大) sector, the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries (農水產部) accounts for 40% of all business types (11 participating agencies (部處), 30 businesses (事業)).

Second, in the spiritual development (精神啓發) sector, the Ministry of Home Affairs (內務部), the Ministry of Education (文敎部), the Ministry of Culture and Public Information (文公部), etc., are in charge of many businesses (事業) with significant weight (比重).

Third, among the major business sectors (主要事業部門) such as production base (生產基盤), income increase (所得增大), welfare environment (福祉環境), and spiritual development (精神啓發), the number of participating agencies (部處) in the spiritual development (精神啓發) sector is the highest, with 17 agencies (部處). Next, 11 agencies (部處) each participate in the income increase (所得增大) and welfare environment (福祉環境) sectors, while 7 agencies (部處) participate in the production base (生產基盤) sector.

Meanwhile, such a business structure has been compiled in relation to the purpose (目的) of the SAemaul Movement (運動), considering the improvement of the consciousness structure (意識構造), environmental improvement (環境改善), and the formation of the national total system (國民總和體制). It includes everything from the social (社會), economic (經濟), and political (政治) aspects, as well as the potential (潜在的) and unconscious (無意識的) intentions (意圖).

## 2. Promotion System (推進體系) by Business (事業別)

Although the structure (構造) of SAemaul businesses (事業) has been examined above, to achieve the goals of the SAemaul Movement (運動) of constructing a "sound and rational" local community (地域社會), spiritual development (精神啓發) businesses (事業) are necessary. To construct a "convenient and beautiful" local community (地域社會), environmental improvement (環境改善) businesses (事業) are necessary, and to construct a "prosperous and blessed" local community (地域社會), production (生產) and income increase (所得增大) businesses (事業) are necessary.

Examining the organizational (組織) system (體系) that actually promotes all such businesses (事業), the following is as follows.

a. Characteristics (特徵) of the Promotion System (推進體系) by Business (事業別)

# Chapter 3 (第3章) The Implementation System of the Saemaul Undong (새마을運動)

In the Saemaul Undong (새마을運動), the leadership in its execution should ultimately lie with the villagers.

In other words, in the Saemaul Undong (새마을運動), the villagers should be the primary actors, while external guiding agencies should play a secondary role. However, in the case of South Korea's Saemaul Undong (새마을運動), due to various factors, the functions of external guiding agencies hold a very important position.

On the other hand, when looking at the process of actually pushing forward with projects, the roles of functional organizations and informal, self-generated organizations of local residents stand out. As a result, there are considerable issues with the efficient functioning of residents' organizations, leading to diminished expectations.

The issues with functional organizations are, first, that most of these organizations are established in a top-down manner through laws, administrative orders, or administrative directives. This has led to a lack of solidarity among members and a potential disinterest among residents.

Secondly, there are many nominal but ineffective organizations. In fact, there are organizations whose very existence is difficult to ascertain (e.g., village libraries).

Thirdly, there are many overlapping organizations. For instance, the youth association (靑年會), the 4-H Club (4H俱), and the women's association (婦女會) often have overlapping functions with the lifestyle improvement club (生活改善 俱樂部).

However, the most notable characteristic of the organizational structure for Saemaul projects is that organizations are segmented according to the nature of the projects and that these organizations are operated with residents as their core.

## B. Project-Specific Implementation System

### (1) Implementation System for Production Infrastructure Projects

As previously discussed in the business structure, the specific contents of production infrastructure projects vary slightly each year, and there are many such projects. Each project is under the jurisdiction of a specific administrative agency, and these agencies support, supervise, and promote the projects through their administrative networks down to the local level. Let's examine the implementation organizational structure based on a few representative projects.

#### (a) Saemaul Cooperative Circle Projects

##### ① Meaning of the Project: Saemaul Cooperative Circle Projects refer to projects where two or more adjacent villages, based on their topography,


--- (p. 208) ---

Marketplaces (市場), school districts (學區), farmlands (耕地), and traditional characteristics (傳統性), among other similar living conditions, serve as the foundation for mutual cooperation. Through this cooperation, villages undertake joint projects (共同宿願事業) such as road construction (道路), agricultural water supply (農梁用水), and river improvement (河川整備) to strengthen the cooperative system (協同體制) among villages and enhance investment effects (投資効果). The Saemaul Undong (新村運動) involves villages within the same township (邑面), county (郡), or province (道), as well as several neighboring villages from different townships, counties, or provinces participating in and promoting regional Saemaul projects (廣域新村事業).

<Table 10> Business Planning System (事業計劃樹立體系)

[Diagram: Business Planning System Flowchart]

**Detailed Explanation of the Business Planning System:**

*   **Each Village (村) within the Region (圏域)**
    *   Establish village-specific (村別) hopeful business plans (希望事業計劃)
    *   Business selection (選定) by the village promotion committee (里洞推進委員會)
*   **Cooperative Regional Business Promotion Committee (協同圈事業推進委員會)**
    *   Deliberation (審議) and adjustment (調整) of proposed businesses (提案事業) from each village
    *   Selection (選定) of joint cooperative businesses (共同協同事業)
*   **Township (邑) and Village (面) Heads (長)**
    *   Adjustment (調整) of village-specific (村別) interests (利害關係)
    *   Determination (裁定) of business priority (優先順位)
*   **County Governor (郡守)**
    *   Review (檢討) of business suitability (適合性) and economic viability (經濟性)
    *   Determination (決定) of support amount (支援量) by region (圏域別)
*   **Provincial Governor (道知事)**
    *   Adjustment (調整) of businesses (事業) by region (圏域別)
    *   Approval (審查確定) and reporting (報告) of plans (計劃)
*   **Ministry of Home Affairs (內務部)**
    *   Review (檢討) and guidance (指導) • supervision (監督) of plan promotion (推進)

②. Composition (構成) and Functions (機能) of the Promotion Committee (推進委員會)
As the promotional organization (推進組織) for businesses (事業), "OO Region Cooperative Regional Business Promotion Committee (OO地域協同圈事業推進委員會)" is established by region (地域別). The number of committee members (委員數) is 7-8 people, determined within the region (圏域內), and appointed by the county governor (郡守). (Saemaul leaders, village heads (里洞長), agricultural cooperative (農協) managers, fishing village (漁村) contract managers (契長), forestry (山林) contract managers (契長), youth association (靑年會) presidents, women's association (婦女會) presidents, school principals (學校長))
Meanwhile, the committee chairperson (委員長) is elected (互選) among the members (委員), and the deputy township/village head (副邑面長) is designated (指定) as an auditor (監事) for the committee (委員會).
The main functions (機能) include deliberating and adjusting proposed businesses (提案事業) from each village before deciding on the businesses (事業). Additionally, they manage and operate the funds (資金) associated with the businesses (事業). Funds (資金)

### Chapter 3: The Implementation System of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement)

Looking at the management organization (管理組織), the committee (委員會) includes 3 or more Saemaul leaders (指導者) from participating villages and a committee chairperson (委員長), who jointly manage (共同管理) the committee. The managers (管理者) are responsible for drafting business plans (事業計劃), budget execution (豫算執行), and the outcomes of decisions (決定結果).

On the other hand, the support system (支援體系) appoints administrative guidance (行政指導) officials (公務員) at the provincial (道) level, with the head of the Internal Affairs Bureau (內務局長) as the overall responsible officer (總責任官) and the business guidance deputy director (事業指導補佐官) as the director of the business-related department (事業關聯課長). At the county (郡) level, the responsible officer (責任官) is the county magistrate (郡守), the business guidance officer (事業指導官) is the director of the business-managing department (事業主管課長), and a technical guidance team (技術指導班) (technical staff (技術職) + general officials (一般公務員)) is formed to handle administrative guidance (行政指導) and technical guidance (技術指導).

#### (b) Rural Electrification Project (農漁村電化事業)

1. **Project Significance (事業意義)**: The rural electrification project (農漁村電化事業) aims to fully electrify rural areas (農漁村), contributing to improved living environments (生活環境改善) and increased income (所得增大). Initially, this project was under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (商工部), but it was transferred to the Ministry of Energy and Resources (動力資源部) when the latter was established.
2. **Project Implementation System (事業推進體系)**: This project begins with the allocation of loan funds (融資金配定) from the central government (中央部處) to the provincial governor (道知事), who then negotiates with the county magistrate (郡守) to select the electrification regions (電化地域選定). The Korea Electric Power Corporation (韓電) then confirms the project and proceeds with the design (設計) upon request, while the county magistrate (郡守) notifies the residents (住民) of the selected region (地域選定通報).

[Diagram: Rural Electrification Project Implementation System]
**<Table 11> Rural Electrification Project (農漁村電化事業) Implementation System (推進體制)**

This diagram illustrates the implementation system (推進體制) of the rural electrification project (農漁村電化事業). The interactions among the participating entities are as follows:

*   **Ministry of Commerce and Industry (商工部) → Ministry of Energy and Resources (動力資源部)**
    *   ① Loan Fund Allocation (融資金配定): The central government allocates loan funds to the provincial governor (道知事).

*   **Provincial Governor (道知事)**
    *   ② Electrification Region Selection (電化地域選定): The governor negotiates with the county magistrate (郡守) to select the electrification regions (電化地域).
    *   ④ Design Request (設計依頼): The governor requests the Korea Electric Power Corporation (韓電) (branch office (支店)·business office (營業所)) to design the project.
    *   ⑤ Project Confirmation (事業確定): The governor receives project confirmation (事業確定) from the Korea Electric Power Corporation (韓電).

*   **County Magistrate (郡守)**
    *   ② Electrification Region Selection (電化地域選定): The magistrate negotiates with the provincial governor (道知事) to select the electrification regions (電化地域).
    *   ③ Electrification Region Notification (電化地域通報): The magistrate notifies the residents (住民) of the selected electrification regions (電化地域).

*   **Residents (住民)**
    *   ③ Receive Electrification Region Notification (電化地域通報): The residents receive notification of the selected electrification regions (電化地域) from the county magistrate (郡守).
    *   ⑦ Internal Line Construction Contract (內線工事契約施工): The residents contract with electrical construction companies (電氣工事事業者) for internal line construction (內線工事) and proceed with the construction.
    *   ⑨ Receive Power Supply (電力供給): The residents receive power supply (電力供給) from the Korea Electric Power Corporation (韓電).

*   **Korea Electric Power Corporation (韓電) (Branch Office (支店)·Business Office (營業所))**
    *   ④ Receive Design Request (設計依頼): The corporation receives the design request (設計依頼) from the provincial governor (道知事).
    *   ⑤ Project Confirmation (事業確定): The corporation notifies the provincial governor (道知事) of the project confirmation (事業確定).
    *   ⑥ Power Supply Confirmation (電力供給確認) and Project Construction (事業工事): The corporation confirms power supply (電力供給) to the residents (住民) and proceeds with the project construction (事業工事) (including external lines (外線)).
    *   ⑧ External Line Construction Contract (外線工事契約): The corporation contracts with electrical construction companies (電氣工事事業者) for external line construction (外線工事).
    *   ⑨ Power Supply (電力供給): The corporation supplies power (電力供給) to the residents (住民).
    *   ⑩ Perform Completion Inspection (竣工檢査): The corporation conducts a completion inspection (竣工檢査) of the construction completed by the electrical construction companies (電氣工事事業者).

*   **Electrical Construction Companies (電氣工事事業者) (Licensed Businesses (免許業者))**
    *   ⑦ Internal Line Construction Contract (內線工事契約施工): The companies contract with residents (住民) for internal line construction (內線工事) and proceed with the construction.
    *   ⑧ External Line Construction Contract (外線工事契約): The companies contract with the Korea Electric Power Corporation (韓電) for external line construction (外線工事).
    *   ⑩ Request Completion Inspection (竣工檢査): The companies request a completion inspection (竣工檢査) from the Korea Electric Power Corporation (韓電).

1. **Meaning (意味) of the Business (事業)**:
   As part of the income (所得) augmentation (增大) business (事業) for rural (農村) areas, the production (生產) cooperative (協同) business (事業) includes:
   - Rice (벼) cluster (團地) farming (營農)
   - Barley (보리) cluster (團地) farming (營農)

   - Sideline (副業) clusters (團地)

   All these initiatives contribute to income (所得) augmentation (增大) through variety (品種) improvement (改良) and the introduction (導入) of new technologies (新技術).

2. **Farming (營農) Association (會) Organization (組織)**:
   The mayor (邑長) and county magistrate (郡守) organize farming (營農) associations (會). The Saemaul (새마을) leader (指導者) serves as the cluster (團地) president (會長), under whom there are cultivation (栽培) teams (班), irrigation (水利) teams (班), and pest control (防除) teams (班). All farming households (農家) within the cluster (團地) are members (會員) of the association (會).〈Table 12〉

4. **Organization (組織) of Crop (作目) Teams (班)**:
   Crop (作目) teams (班) are organized with an increase (增產) team leader (班長) at the helm, supported by work (作業) groups (組), technical (技術) groups (組), facility (施設) groups (組), material (資材) procurement (購入) groups (組), sales (販賣) groups (組), and savings (貯蓄) groups (組).

   The operation (運營) involves holding general (總) meetings (會) of team members (班員) at least twice a month and team leader (組長) meetings (會議) at least once a week. At least 20% of farming (營農) funds (資金) are reserved (積立) for operation (運營). The primary (主要) functions (機能) of the crop (作目) teams (班) include:
   - Selecting (選擇) superior (優良) varieties (品種) to enhance (提高) marketability (商品性)
   - Coordinating (共同) sales (出荷) to boost (增大) income (所得)
   - Introducing (導入) new technologies (新技術) and implementing (實踐) joint (共同) work (作業) plans (計劃)
   - Formulating (樹立) farming (營農) improvement (改善) plans (方案) and allocating (割當) necessary (所要) funds (資金) and materials (資材)

## (Na) Income-Generating Business (經營所得事業)

### ① Meaning of Business (事業의 의미):
An income-generating business (經營所得事業) is a community-centered business (마을단위) where the majority of residents (住民多數) participate jointly (共同) in activities suitable for the village's conditions (마을 여건). Through autonomous cooperation (自律的인 협동) in labor (勞力), capital (资本), technology (技術), and management (經營管理面), the business aims to increase profits (收益) and serve as a central force (求心事業) for enhancing village income (마을 소득).

### ② Promotion System (推進體系):
The main entity (主體) of this business (事業) is the village residents (마을 주민). However, the command structure (指揮體系) for promoting the business (事業) centered around the village residents (마을 주민을 중심) follows a certain system (일정한 체계) from village→gun (郡)→do (道)→Ministry of Home Affairs (內務部), with each performing its major tasks (主要業務). ## (Da) New Community Income Increase Comprehensive Development Business (綜合開發事業)

### ① Meaning of Business (事業의 의의):
The purpose of this business (事業) is to perpetuate (永續化) the New Community Movement (運動) and build a welfare-oriented rural community (福祉農村). To achieve this, it aims to comprehensively develop (綜合開發) existing resources (賦存資源), specialize (特化) regional farming (地域營農), and comprehensively develop (綜合開發) production (生産) and circulation (流通) centered around the economic zones (經濟圏) of towns (邑) and townships (面).

### ② Business Promotion System (事業의 추진體制):
This business (事業) is divided into stages (段階別) such as village units (마을단위), town/township units (邑ㆍ면단위), county units (郡단위), provincial units (道단위), and central units (中央단위). A step-by-step (段階別) business promotion (事業推進) and guidance/supervision system (指導監督體系) has been established. Additionally, comprehensive development business (綜合開發事業) support consultation councils (支援協議會) are formed (構成) and operated (運營) at each stage (各段階別). In particular, the president of the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation (農協中央會長) strengthens the business acceptance (事業受容) posture (態勢) of unit cooperatives (單位組合) by taking necessary measures (조).

(a) Housing Improvement Projects

### Chapter 3: The Implementation System of the Saemaul Undong (New Community Movement)

① Meaning of the Project: This project is a Saemaul Undong initiative aimed at improving the living environment in rural areas through housing improvements (including roof improvements and the renovation of poor-quality houses along roadsides). It allows thatch from traditional grass-roofed houses (초가) to be used as fuel, fertilizer, or raw materials for production. Additionally, it aims to improve the structure of rural settlements and serve as a model for housing improvements by renovating poorly constructed houses along roadsides.

② Local Improvement Implementation System: With the Ministry of the Interior (내무부) at its center, this system involves cities (시), provinces (도), counties (군), towns (읍), townships (면), and neighborhoods (동), as well as individual farm households. The system functions systematically as follows. First, the Ministry of the Interior examines the progress of the project from the ministry level down to the village level. The ministry allocates project plans and funds to cities and provinces and instructs them on material unit price agreements. Cities and provinces then instruct counties on their own plans, reallocate funds, and inspect material quality. Counties provide support funds to towns, townships, and neighborhoods and conclude material supply contracts. Towns and townships notify villages of project quantity allocations, purchase materials from contractors, and guide the progress of the project.

On the other hand, in the top-down system, towns, townships, and neighborhoods select target beneficiaries, report on loan repayments, apply for funds, and report on progress to cities and counties. Cities and provinces report project plans to the Ministry of the Interior, manage loans, confirm and report project plans, and report on progress.

③ Slum Clearance Project Implementation System: This project is also carried out under the guidance and support system of the Ministry of the Interior. It can be summarized as follows (Table 16):

(Table 16)

(Na) Mining Area Improvement Project
① Project Goals: The goals of this project are to improve living environments and foster a sense of settlement through the phased improvement of backward mining villages (광산촌). It aims to develop the Saemaul spirit and includes key improvement projects such as infrastructure development, housing improvements, health and sanitation, and other projects.

② Implementation Organization: To implement the mining area improvement project, a "○○Mining Area Improvement Project Promotion Committee" is established for each mine. Saemaul Undong projects at the village level are carried out under the supervision of the committee.

The composition of the committee includes the head of the town (읍) or township (면) as the chairperson, and committee members.

The leaders of the respective villages (當該) include the village chief (里長), Saemaul leaders (指導者), and mining owners (鑛業主) (or the manager of the on-site business (事業所長)).

The Mining Area (鑛山) Improvement Project Promotion Committee (地區 正備事業推進委員會) is responsible for establishing monthly (月別), village-specific (마을別), and detailed (細部) work plans (作業計劃), as well as overseeing the overall direction (指揮總括) of the project promotion. This contributes to the effective (效果的) implementation (遂行) of the project's objectives (目的).

Meanwhile, depending on the nature of the project (性質), projects such as resident self-help (住民自力) projects and Saemaul beautification projects (新村美化事業) (material support (資材支援) + resident labor burden (住民勞力負擔)) are promoted under the auspices of the committee (委員會). Saemaul labor income projects (新村勞力所得事業) (material support (資材支援) + wage payment (勞賃支給)) are promoted as direct operations (直營事業) by the county (郡) and township (邑面), with the committee (委員會) making recommendations (推薦) for local residents (地域住民) to be employed (就勞). General construction projects (一般建設事業) (construction contractor subcontracting (建設業者都給)) are subcontracted (都給) to general construction contractors (一般建設業者) by the province (道) and county (郡) for construction (施工). The general labor sector (一般勞力部門) is promoted as much as possible (可及的) as a project (事業) for local residents (地域住民) to be employed (就勞).

(4) System for Promoting Spiritual Development (精神啓發) Projects

(a) Organization of Saemaul Libraries (新村文庫)

The organization of Saemaul Libraries (新村文庫) consists of a hierarchical structure that includes the Saemaul Library Headquarters (新村文庫本部), provincial branches (道支部), city and county branches (市•郡支部), and Saemaul Library associations (新村文庫會). This organizational structure is guided and supervised by the Ministry of the Interior (內務部), governors (道知事), mayors (市長) and county magistrates (郡守), and town and township heads (邑•面長). The central organization (中央組織) includes a General Affairs Bureau (事務局) headed by a director (長), as well as Publishing (出版部), Guidance (指導部), and General Affairs (總務部) departments. It also includes an Editorial Committee (編輯委員會) and a Guidance Committee (指導委員會). At the village level (마을單位), there are Saemaul Library associations (新村文庫會) that work with village youth (마을靑壯年).

(Organized with 10 or more members (名), and the library president (文庫會長) is appointed as a member (委員) of the village development committee (마을開發委員會).)

### (B) New Life Movement (새생활運動) for Women (婦女層)
The New Life (새生活) Movement (運動) for women (婦女層) includes the Inbo Movement (隣保運動) and the Social Atmosphere Purification Movement (社會氣風 순화운동). The Inbo Movement (隣保運動) refers to a neighborhood mutual aid movement (運動) centered around women (婦女者), while the latter movement (運動) is a movement (運動) to establish social discipline (社會紀綱) for the realization (具現) of social justice (社會正義).
Here, we examine the implementation organization (推進組織) of the Social Atmosphere Purification Movement (社會氣風 순化運動).
Organization (組織): In rural areas (農村), the main entities (主體) of this movement (運動) are the women's classes (婦女敎室) in each city (市) and province (道), while in urban areas (都市), they are women's organizations (女性團體), women's classes (婦女敎室), women's halls (女性會舘), and women's business halls (婦女事業舘). These various organizations (諸組織體) take the form of housewives' universities (主婦大學), technical extension classes (技術普及班), school-based mothers' associations (學區單位 姉母會), and instructor trainers (指導者 教官) to disseminate content (內容) such as civic spirit development (市民 精神啓發), rural (農村) and urban (都市) environmental improvement (環境改善), and production increase (生產增大) to each household (各 家庭) through the terminal women's classes (末端婦女敎室).
The organization (組織) of this movement (運動) is operated under the administrative guidance (行政指導) and support (支援) of the Ministry of Health and Social Affairs (保健社會部).

### (5) Implementation System (推進體系) of the Saemaul Undong (새마을운동) in Factories (工場)
(A) Meaning (意味) of the Movement (運動): The Saemaul Undong (새마을운동) in factories (工場) is, in a word, a movement (運動) in which businesspeople (企業人) and workers (勤勞者) trust and help each other, work together with one heart, and strive to live well together. The main content (事業內容) of this movement (運動) being promoted (推進) includes cost reduction (原價節減), quality control, material savings, efficiency improvement, and work improvement, covering all aspects of management improvement (經營改善). It also includes operating attached schools (附設學校) and evening special schools (夜間 特別學校) for each industry (產業體別).

(B) Implementation Organization (推進組織): The Saemaul Undong (새마을운동) in factories (工場) began at the end of 1973 as part of the urban Saemaul Undong (都市 새마을운동), but in March 1977, it was completely separated from the urban Saemaul Undong (都市 새마을운동), with the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (商工部) overseeing the factory Saemaul Undong (工場 새마을운동) and the Ministry of Home Affairs (內務部) overseeing the urban Saemaul Undong (都市 새마을운동).
Meanwhile, to promote the independent (獨自的) implementation (推進) of the Saemaul Undong (새마을운동) in factories (工場), in March 1977, the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (商工部) established the Factory Saemaul Planning Division (企劃課) and Guidance Division (指導課). However, as of August 1980, the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (商工部) has reorganized its structure (機構) into the Factory Saemaul Officer System (擔當官制) to provide administrative guidance (行政指導) on factory Saemaul Undong (工場 새마을운동) affairs, and has directed the city (市) and provincial (道) commerce and industry bureaus (商工局) to participate directly (直接) in administrative guidance (行政指導).
Furthermore, in February 1977, the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry (大韓商工會議所) established the Factory Saemaul Undong (工場 새마을운동) Promotion Headquarters (推進本部) to plan (企劃), guide (指導), and evaluate (評價) the Factory Saemaul Undong (工場 새마을운동), as well as to educate (敎育) businesspeople (企業人) and employees (從業員), and to investigate (調査) and analyze (分析) the promotion status (推進狀況) and actual conditions (實態) of the Factory Saemaul Undong (工場 새마을운동).

## Promotion System of the Urban Saemaul Undong (都市새마을運動)

As sub-systems (下位體系) of the Urban Saemaul Undong (都市새마을運動), there are households (家庭), villages, workplaces (職場), and schools (學校), each of which serves as a promotion entity (事業推進主體) for various initiatives.

The promotion bodies (推進體) of the Urban Saemaul Undong (都市새마을運動) include the Saemaul Women's Guidance Council (새마을婦女指導協議會) and the Private Sector Saemaul Undong Council (民間團體新村運動協議會), among others.

Since the Saemaul Undong Council (新村運動協議會) has been explained earlier, it will be omitted here, and instead, we will focus on the Private Sector Council (民間團體協議會).

The Private Sector Saemaul Undong Council (新村運動協議會) was established as a leading body (先導的) for the Workplace Saemaul Undong (職場新村運動).

Its organization includes a Central Council (中央協議會) with City and Provincial Councils (市道協議會) under its jurisdiction in Seoul Special City (서울特別市), Busan Directly Governed City (釜山直轄市), and each province (各道). Furthermore, each City and Provincial Council (市道協議會) has City, County, and District Councils (市•郡•區協議會) under its jurisdiction. The members (會員) of the Seoul Special City (서울特別市) and Busan Directly Governed City (釜山直轄市) Councils (協議會) are under the jurisdiction (管) of the respective City and Province (市道).
